blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday said indigenous communities and their burial sites would not be displaced as the government moves forward with the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative. During a brief question-and-answer session at Malacañang Palace, he said the government would handle the matter with sensitivity. “We are very sensitive to that. That’s not something that people should worry about. We are very sensitive about such cultural concerns, and those are very much part of the discussions,” he said after the oath-taking ceremony of newly elected officers of the Malacañang Media Groups at the President’s Hall in Malacañang […]...
